slowest_experiments.title: Math Iterative Self-Repair v1 — Execute-Feedback on 25 GSM8K problems
slowest_experiments.root_cause: Iterative repair loop over 25 math problems with execute-feedback cycle; each repair attempt triggers a new LLM inference call; multi-turn execution accumulates latency; GSM8K extraction failing (TP=0) means full quota of attempts consumed before early-exit
slowest_experiments.action_required: Add early-exit gate when extraction_tp_rate=0 on first batch; do not spend full 25q budget when extraction is evidently broken

bottlenecks_identified: PLANNER PRIOR_FAILURES GAP (primary): 6 of 13 planned experiments (exp1080/1082/1083/1085/1086 + 1 more) blocked by conductor gate-check because roadmap YAML omitted required prior_failures declarations; these experiments had documented prior failures but the planner did not consult research-complete.yaml before proposing them; 46% of the milestone was consumed by gate-blocked work that could have been resolved at planning time

GEMINI BACKEND SINGLE-POINT DEPENDENCY: exp1078 (position paper, 80-turn gemini task) and exp1087 (gemini worktree conductor, MANDATORY) both routed exclusively through gemini; gemini-3.1-pro-preview was paused mid-milestone due to 429 rate limits; two strategic deliverables evaporated simultaneously with no fallback route declared in roadmap YAML; position paper arXiv deadline (2026-05-15) now critically at risk

FPGA BOARD UNREACHABILITY: exp1081 KV260 scale benchmark required live board at 192.168.51.98; board did not respond; no pre-check gate in roadmap YAML confirmed board is reachable before queuing the experiment; resulted in crossover extrapolated from prior anchor (exp1068) rather than live-measured, weakening the claim

EXP 906 EXCLUSION MANIFEST REGRESSION: exp906 (Code Repair 50q IterativeSelfRepair, 35 min) appeared as slowest experiment in .84 conductor log despite being added to exclusion manifest in milestone .80; this is a regression in manifest enforcement — the experiment that cost 154 min/milestone across milestones .73–.79 is apparently escaping retirement; cumulative waste across re-appearances must be audited

SEQUENTIAL GPU EXECUTION: GPU monitor at milestone close shows both RTX 3090s at 0% utilization and 4 MB allocated; DualGPURunner was available and recommended by the monitor but not used; GPU-heavy experiments ran sequentially on one GPU while the second sat idle; DualGPURunner could have parallelized Qwen on GPU 0 with Gemma on GPU 1 for ~1.96x throughput improvement

GATE CASCADE DEPENDENCY CHAIN: exp1086 (N-Queens cartridge) was blocked by gate-check, which caused exp1088 (HF Spaces gallery update) to also fail with zero wall time; the gallery update is an independent deliverable (existing cartridges can be deployed without new ones) but was chained into the N-Queens dependency, amplifying a single block into two failures

DOC RECONCILIATION SYNCHRONOUS OVERHEAD: in-process doc reconciliation for complex experiments (28 min for exp950) runs synchronously in the conductor loop; reconciling large result JSONs against multiple markdown files while holding the conductor loop creates unnecessary sequential latency

GSMSYSTEM EXTRACTION STILL BROKEN: exp1079 confirmed GSM8K extraction_tp_rate=0 for the second consecutive milestone; VeriCoT extraction fails on math reasoning tasks; experiments consuming the full GSM8K budget (100 questions) with zero extraction yield produce no useful signal at significant compute cost; no early-exit heuristic is in place
improvements_suggested: ADD PRIOR_FAILURES PRE-AUDIT TASK AS MILESTONE SLOT 0: make a dedicated 'prior_failures_audit' experiment the first non-negotiable task in every milestone YAML; this task scans research-complete.yaml, results/operational_retro_*.json, and ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml against all proposed experiments, then patches any missing prior_failures declarations before the conductor activates the milestone; estimated savings: ~90 min/milestone (6 gate-blocked experiments avoided)

REQUIRE DUAL-BACKEND FALLBACK DECLARATION IN ROADMAP: any experiment routing through a closed LLM backend (gemini, codex, claude-via-api) must declare a fallback_backend field in research-roadmap-next.yaml (e.g., fallback_backend: opus); conductor activates fallback automatically if primary backend returns 429/503/timeout three consecutive times; estimated savings: ~80 min/milestone (position paper + gemini conductor recovered)

ADD FPGA BOARD PRE-CHECK AS MANDATORY GATE CONDITION: any experiment gated on FPGA hardware must first pass a board_reachable: true gate; implement a lightweight board_probe task (< 30s SSH ping to 192.168.51.98) as a prerequisite; skip FPGA experiments automatically when board_reachable=false with an explicit blocked_board_unreachable verdict; estimated savings: ~5 min direct, ~15 min researcher attention savings

USE DualGPURunner FOR ALL GPU EXPERIMENTS BY DEFAULT: explicitly schedule GPU-heavy experiments as paired tasks (Qwen on GPU 0, Gemma on GPU 1) using the existing DualGPURunner harness; single-GPU experiments should require a justification comment in the roadmap YAML; GPU parallelism was validated at 1.96x speedup in .52; estimated savings: ~60 min/milestone on GPU-heavy milestones

DECOUPLE GALLERY UPDATES FROM NEW CARTRIDGE EXPERIMENTS: the HF Spaces gallery update should be a standalone experiment with no dependency on new cartridges; it can deploy whichever cartridges are currently in the repo (Sudoku, GTW, Lights Out, etc.) regardless of whether new ones were added this milestone; estimated savings: ~15 min (prevents a single gate-block from killing an otherwise-complete deliverable)

AUDIT AND RECONFIRM EXCLUSION MANIFEST ENFORCEMENT: run an exclusion manifest integrity check as part of every conductor startup sequence; verify that all entries in ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml are present in the conductor's runtime exclusion set and that none of the retired experiment IDs appear in the proposed task list; exp906 reappearing in .84 despite .80 retirement is a regression that must be closed

ADD EARLY-EXIT HEURISTIC FOR ZERO-YIELD EXTRACTION: when extraction_tp_rate=0 on the first batch of a GSM8K/math benchmark run, log the result and terminate the experiment with honest_verdict='extraction_broken_no_yield' rather than consuming the full question budget; estimated savings: ~30-50 min/milestone when extraction is evidently broken

BATCH DOC RECONCILIATION PASSES: collect in-process doc updates in a queue during the conductor run and flush them in a single batch reconciliation pass at natural breakpoints (e.g., after each phase boundary, not after every experiment); reduces sequential I/O overhead in the conductor loop; estimated savings: ~20-30 min/milestone on reconciliation-heavy milestones
